items.summary: Disposition: blocked. Keep SearchWoot private and leave rights outreach unsent. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution, historical derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; current public terms point against those uses. SearchWoot data-flow evidence is partial, GA4 consent/configuration evidence is partial, and logs/vendors/incident evidence is incomplete. Non-legal gates are also blocked for accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security/release. Fleet compliance is only a technical baseline: 36 pass, 19 fail, 6 unknown, including 19 banner/consent/GA4 failure sets and 4 privacy/terms findings. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, public data display, historical derivatives, alerts, affiliate/advertising use, and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering authoritative Woot terms/permission, data flow and retention, deployed consent and GA4 settings, and logs/vendors/incident handling; close no task without evidence.

Conditional only after capacity is released. The existing CTA refinement may proceed only within the already approved scope: CTA hierarchy, adjacent affiliate disclosure, unchanged destinations, keyboard focus, contrast, tap targets, responsive layout, and deterministic validation. No new routes, dependencies, credentials, permissions, telemetry, data collection, cross-site behavior, or monetization claims. Require tests, build, link validation, smoke, accessibility evidence, and single-diff rollback evidence.

Retain the existing boundary: Amazon reporting covers 2026-09-21 with 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row remains unassigned; named tracking rows do not evidence site-attributed income. Do not publish site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal-lift claims. Require registered tracking IDs and same-period reconciliation before future financial claims.
